svg.title: The scheduler's token budget, two steps side by side
svg.desc: Two horizontal bars, each an 8,192-token scheduler step budget to scale. The first step has only 64 decode tokens, one tiny sliver per running sequence, so the chunked-prefill chunk fills nearly the whole 8,192-token budget at 8,128 tokens. The second step has 2,048 decode tokens as more sequences have joined, so the chunked-prefill chunk shrinks to 6,144 tokens. The decode portion is drawn as a hatched texture to suggest many tiny per-sequence slivers; the prefill chunk is a single solid block.

text.font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One token budget, two steps: the prefill chunk shrinks as decodes join
